bench_harness: VERIFIED, read the script: tests/bench_decode.py + docs/REFERENCE.md 'Decode (this kit, 2026-08-28)' + scripts/boot-shape-warmup.sh + scripts/spec-accept-gate.sh. tests/bench_decode.py drives the live OpenAI API at 127.0.0.1:8888 with STREAMING /v1/chat/completions and counts tok/s = (completion_tokens - 1) / (end_time - first_token_time); fixed prompts: prose 'Write a detailed step-by-step explanation of how a hash map works, including collision handling, resizing, and time complexity. Be thorough.'; structured 'Count from 1 to 200. Output only the numbers, separated by spaces. No other text.'; code 'Write a Python function named clamp_range ... [0, 50]. Include a short docstring.'
